title: ClassAnalyzer
question: How can someone make sense of a classroom session through the interface?
summary: ClassAnalyzer is a classroom observation prototype. Its camera overlay keeps a tracking ID in view and starts a countdown if the track goes missing. The countdown gives a reviewer a concrete moment to check.

provenance.scope: Project scope and intended processing model.
Cross-platform CI changes under Subhasis’s public GitHub account.
Tracking IDs, missing-track countdown, and recovery on a match.

decision.title: Give a dropped track a visible state
decision.description: The overlay uses a tracking ID and a countdown to make the gap visible. When the tracker matches a detection to that ID again, it clears the alert. A reviewer can distinguish that gap from a continuous observation.

caseStudy.limitation: Tracking IDs and countdowns are model observations. A gap could reflect occlusion, someone moving out of frame, or a tracking error. The example uses fictional data.
